sources.title: Broncos HC Sean Payton announces that the team has suspended RB J.K. Dobbins for one game
sources.description: Wow! Denver Broncos Head Coach Sean Payton met with the media today for the first time before their Black Friday game vs. the Pittsburgh Steelers and dropped a bombshell. He announced that veteran running back JK Dobbins has been suspended for one game due to conduct detrimental to the team. Dobbins was not present for […]
